about_the_game:
Dead by Daylight’s Five Nights at Freddy's includes a new Killer, Springtrap. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Stack of Pizzas badge and the Vent Crawl banner.

THE ANIMATRONIC

A monstrosity of flesh and metal, Springtrap’s bloodstained past is littered with the innocent dead. His horrifying innovations are a reminder that beneath the cruelty lies a brilliant inventor, whose creations brought laughter and screams to the same unfortunate audience.

Springtrap Power: Fazbear's Fright

The Animatronic can launch a powerful projectile, which embeds itself in a Survivor and makes them susceptible to a terrifying close-range grab attack. They will be Broken, Oblivious, and unable to heal until they remove the projectile.

A near miss will briefly highlight the Survivor with Killer Instinct. You may automatically recall the projectile back to your hand.

Map Feature: Security Doors & Room

At the start of the Trial, 7 Security Doors are spawned throughout the Map. They can be accessed by Springtrap and the Survivors.

Upon entering a Security Door as Springtrap, you will see the Aura of every Security Door on the Map. You can exit from any one of them, allowing you to traverse across the Map. If you exit into a room occupied by a Survivor, they will be instantly grabbed.

When a Survivor enters a Security Door, they will enter a unique Security Room. They can then cycle through every Camera on the Map, open and close doors, and exit from whichever door they please.

All Survivors will share a collective amount of Battery Power, which effects their ability to interact with Doors and Cameras. When Batter Power reaches zero, they will be unable to enter Security Doors until it recharges.

Springtrap comes with 3 new perks.

Help Wanted:

Damage a Generator to make it Compromised. When the Compromised Generator is repaired, your Basic Attacks have a shorter cooldown for a duration.

Phantom Fear:

When a Survivor in your Terror Radius looks at you, they scream and briefly reveal their Aura. This Perk has a short cooldown.

Haywire:

Exit Gates will steadily regress. While regressing, Survivors will see the lights randomly flicker.

NEW MAP: FREDDY FAZBEAR'S PIZZA*

The rotting brainchild of a sadistic murderer still stands over the grassy plains. A place of joy for some, and unspeakable terror for others. Do not let the bright colors and parlor tricks deceive you; many have died within these walls, and many more will die still.*This map is free for all players.

EXCLUSIVE CHAPTER ITEMS: STACK OF PIZZAS BADGE AND VENT CRAWL BANNER

It's not a party if you don't have any pizza. The Five Nights at Freddy's Chapter includes an exclusive Stack of Pizzas badge and the Vent Crawl banner, only available as part of the DLC. Please note that these items cannot be purchased separately.

He's getting closer... and closer... and closer...
